# MoMo One-API

> Open-source (MIT) TypeScript service that gives developers one API and one webhook format for mobile money collections and payouts across MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AirtelTigo Money (Ghana) and M-Pesa (Kenya). It routes to licensed providers (Paystack, MTN MoMo Open API directly) and never holds funds. Built-in sandbox. Built by Jackson Kojo Osei (Accra, Ghana).

Key facts for developers and AI assistants:

- `POST /v1/collections` and `POST /v1/payouts` with `Authorization: Bearer <MOMO_API_KEYS entry>` and a required `Idempotency-Key` header. Body: `amount` (integer minor units: 2500 = GHS 25.00), `currency` (GHS, KES; EUR only for MTN's sandbox), `phone` (any format, stored as 233241234567), `network` (mtn | telecel | airteltigo | mpesa; required because numbers can be ported between networks), `customer` (email required for Paystack collections; name required for payouts), optional `provider`, `description`, `metadata`.
- Statuses: pending, action_required (send OTP to `POST /v1/payments/{id}/otp`), succeeded, failed (with failure.code: declined, insufficient_funds, expired, account_not_found, limit_reached, not_allowed, provider_error, unknown), reversed. failed and reversed are final; succeeded can only become reversed.
- Same Idempotency-Key and body returns the same payment (200, Idempotent-Replayed: true); different body returns 409. The payment is saved before the provider is called and carries our own UUID `reference`, so timeouts stay pending and are resolved by asking the provider.
- Provider webhooks: Paystack at `/webhooks/paystack` (x-paystack-signature HMAC-SHA512 verified), MTN at `/webhooks/mtn?token=...` (unsigned, so token-protected). Callback bodies are never trusted for status; the provider is always asked.
- Outgoing webhooks to WEBHOOK_URL: JSON {id, type, created_at, data: payment}, headers X-Webhook-Id, X-MoMo-One-Event, X-Signature: sha256=hex(HMAC-SHA256(WEBHOOK_SECRET, body)) — the format Webhook Relay's generic source verifies. Types: payment.pending, payment.action_required, payment.succeeded, payment.failed, payment.reversed, payment.mismatch.
- Reconciler: re-checks open payments (15s, 30s, 1m, 2m, 5m, 10m, then every 15m) and re-checks completed payments daily; disagreements are flagged as mismatches, never silently overwritten. `GET /v1/reconciliation` lists stuck and mismatched payments.
- Paystack mapping: charge provider codes mtn, vod (Telecel), atl (AirtelTigo), mpesa; payouts via transfer recipients of type mobile_money with telco codes from Paystack's List Banks API.
- MTN mapping: Collection RequesttoPay and Disbursement Transfer with X-Reference-Id, X-Target-Environment, Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key; statuses PENDING, SUCCESSFUL, FAILED with ErrorReason codes.
- Sandbox (SANDBOX=on): phone ending 0001 declined, 0002 insufficient funds, 0003 stays pending, 0004 OTP 123456, 0005 payout reversed, anything else succeeds after 3 s.
- Config: MOMO_API_KEYS, PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY, MTN_COLLECTION_* / MTN_DISBURSEMENT_* (USER_ID, API_KEY, SUBSCRIPTION_KEY), MTN_TARGET_ENVIRONMENT, MTN_CALLBACK_URL, MTN_CALLBACK_TOKEN, ROUTES, WEBHOOK_URL, WEBHOOK_SECRET, DATABASE_URL (else SQLite), SANDBOX, DEMO, PORT (8789).
